en.name: Sisinnius
en.summary: A pope of Syrian origin whose reign of barely three weeks was cut short by severe gout that had already afflicted him before his election.
en.body: Sisinnius, already suffering from debilitating gout at the time of his election, reportedly could not feed himself without assistance. His papacy lasted only about three weeks before his death, leaving little opportunity to leave any documented mark beyond an order to prepare lime for repairing the walls of Rome.
